hypothesis: A feature-modulation adapter conditioned on the frozen r5b parent's error at the same two guarded onset frames, and deployed from an exact zero-update trust gate, will reduce complete-future relative L2 on a later disjoint train-only confirmation panel without a numerical or physical wavefield propagator.
expected_mechanism: The parent-onset residual exposes record-specific amplitude and local phase mismatch that raw near-zero onset pressure hides. Offline train-only future supervision learns how this causal residual maps to bounded early-feature modulation; online optimization adjusts only a 16-scalar latent shift and one scalar gate using the two observed frames.
primary_metric: per-record joint space-time relative L2 over deterministic future training frames during meta-training, followed by complete 401-frame float64 relative L2 on a disjoint train-only gate
failure_signal: Non-finite optimization, missing checkpoint, binding mismatch, or failure of the separately preregistered disjoint train gate. A failed train gate forbids frozen validation access for this candidate.
single_conceptual_change: Replace raw-observation conditioning with parent-onset-residual conditioning and a zero-origin deployment trust gate; parent, dataset, observation contract, and no-propagator policy remain fixed.
rollback: Preserve all prior r5b, A3, B2-H, Helmholtz, CPADC, feature-meta, and PI-DeepONet checkpoints. On failure retain the isolated r32 artifacts and do not open validation.
